items.title: Partnership with Axel Springer to deepen beneficial use of AI in journalism
items.summary: Axel Springer is the first publishing house globally to partner with us on a deeper integration of journalism in AI technologies.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI与Axel Springer达成合作，旨在将新闻业更深地整合到AI技术中，属于商业层面的战略合作。
